description: SHARP SHELL GOLDEN, open (SHELL-SHARP-DEFAULT, 2026-10-07). An L-bracket, the profile (0,0) (40,0) (40,10) (10,10) (10,30) (0,30) extruded 25 in z, shelled to a 2 mm wall with its top face (z 25) opened and shell_type 'sharp'. The inside corner of the L, the edge x 10, y 10 along z, is CONCAVE: a sharp shell extends the cavity walls x 8 and y 8 until they meet at (8, 8), as SolidWorks, Onshape and Fusion shell by default, so the wall across that corner is 2 sqrt 2 thick. A rounded (Arc) shell puts an r2 quarter tube round the edge instead and reads 7252.2566 mm^3 with 16 faces; this golden reads the sharp cavity's 7272 with 15. Derived WITHOUT any offset, from the inset L's closed form.
derivation: Hand-derived, no offset used. Base body: the L profile, area 40*10 + 10*20 = 600 mm^2, centroid (15, 10), perimeter 40+10+30+20+10+30 = 140, extruded 25: 15000 mm^3. t = 2, the top face open.

The sharp cavity is the L inset by t with sharp corners: x 2..38 by y 2..8 (216) plus x 2..8 by y 8..28 (120), area 336, perimeter 36+6+30+20+6+26 = 124, from the floor z 2 up through the opening at z 25 (23 deep). cavity = 336*23 = 7728.
surface_area: bottom 600 + outer walls 140*25 = 3500 + the top rim 600 - 336 = 264 + cavity walls 124*23 = 2852 + cavity floor 336 = 7552 mm^2.

topology: 6 outer walls + bottom + rim = 8 faces, 6 cavity walls + floor = 7, so 15; edges: bottom 6 + top outer 6 + 6 vertical, rim inner 6 + 6 cavity vertical + floor 6, so 36; 1 shell (the cavity opens through the top). A rounded shell adds the quarter tube and its 3 edges (16 / 39).

mesh (linear 0.1 mm / angular 0.1 rad, per-face vertices): 12 rectangles at 4 / 2 = 48 / 24, the bottom and the floor (L hexagons) at 6 / 4 = 12 / 8, the rim (an L with an L hole: 12 corners, n + 2h - 2 = 12 triangles) 12 / 12: 72 vertices / 44 triangles.
tolerance_rationale: Planar geometry only, so GProp is exact up to float round-off; measured 2026-10-07 (build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9.3): volume +4.5e-12, surface_area -1.8e-12, centroid +3.6e-15 / -1.8e-15 / +3.6e-15, AABB exact. 1e-9 matches the other shell goldens.
